history.overview: The entrance to Uqua marks the first point of Discord corruption, where ancient seals failed and water became tainted.

timeline.name: Chantry Entrance Constructed
timeline.description: The aquatic civilization built the entrance as a ceremonial gateway.

timeline.name: Discord Breach
timeline.description: Discord ruptures shattered ancient seals, corrupting the water.

timeline.name: Muramite Incursion
timeline.description: Muramite forces established a foothold in the flooded corridors.

timeline.name: Riftseeker Intervention
timeline.description: Riftseekers attempted to stabilize planar leaks but failed to contain deeper fractures.
